name: qoder-nylonme
description: Long-term memory for Qoder via the NylonME memory engine — recall project context at session start, weave decisions and pitfalls as they happen.
descriptionZh: 基于 NylonME 记忆引擎为 Qoder 提供长期记忆——会话开始自动回忆项目上下文，里程碑与坑随手沉淀，跨会话、跨机器、跨工具不丢。

interface.shortDescription: Long-term memory for Qoder — remember across sessions
interface.longDescription: Gives Qoder a persistent memory backed by the NylonME memory engine. Qoder recalls relevant project context at session start (memory_resonate) and weaves decisions, milestones and environment pitfalls at milestones (memory_weave), so knowledge survives across sessions, machines and tools. Runs fully local (embedded engine, data in ~/.nylonme/data) or against a shared team engine via NYLON_SERVER.
defaultPrompt: 回忆一下这个项目最近的里程碑和踩过的坑
把今天这个决定和理由存进记忆
What did we decide about the storage layer last time?
